		1. 📖 Overview
	

🤗 MigrationBench
is a large-scale code migration benchmark dataset at the repository level,
across multiple programming languages.

Current and initial release includes java 8 repositories with the maven build system… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/cxycxy000/migration-bench-java-utg.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (e.g., build/tests pass rate / successful migration rate)
reputation: Emerging repository-level benchmark for code-migration research with limited but growing adoption in the research community.
